name: OeeLossDashboard
tagline: OEE, the six big losses and countermeasures for every line and shift.
description: A PCF control for Power Apps and Power Pages. It calculates OEE (availability × performance × quality) from shift records and shows where the time went: time waterfall, six big losses Pareto with reasons, OEE trend, hourly output against the ideal rate and a line comparison. Supervisors can record countermeasures on the same screen.
features: OEE, A/P/Q KPI rings vs targets
Six big losses Pareto with reason drill-down
OEE by date and hourly output
Sortable line comparison with heat colours
